mapper.select: select t1.id as sourceId, t1.code as sourceCode, 'fbaShipment' as sourceType, t1.delivery_status as status, t2.declare_qty as declareQty, t2.delivery_qty as deliveryQty, t2.receive_qty as receiveQty, t2.delivery_qty - t2.receive_qty as inTransitQty, #{result.replenishmentDetail.calcVersion} as calcVersion from #{tableName} t1 INNER JOIN #{tableDetailName} t2 on t2.is_deleted = false and t2.main_id = t1.id where t1.is_deleted = false and t2.sku_id = #{result.replenishment.skuId} and t1.shop_id = #{result.replenishment.shopId} and (t2.delivery_qty - t2.receive_qty) > 0 and t1.delivery_status = 'shipped'
